translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

book.name: Matyiw
book.title: MATYIW Jiysis Krays Minim Tep Matyiw Tikak

content: Gor Biynimb Diy Kond Mindeniŋgamb Ak, Kesim Ar Biy Rek Mindip
Jiysis tip ak paydoŋ ay aŋgak,
“Gor biynimb diy kond mindeniŋgamb minim ak aspiyn biy rek: “Bi kiyŋ bap ñinuk ak biyn diniŋg gek, tap yomb ñiŋniŋg, keñmaŋgiy dap nan-giy,
binuk gunap aŋgyokiy, biynimb aŋgaynik gok am aŋgem apey, tap yomb ak ñiŋun. Aŋgek am biynimb kun gok kuyip aŋgniŋgambay ak pen; kiyk kirginiŋgambay.

Kun gey binuk gunap pen tip ak aŋgyokiy aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Nimb am biynimb kun gok kuyip aŋgnimimb, “Biyomb ak, makaw yomb gunap, marip gunap pikay, tap okok maŋgiysek moka giy, winiŋgiy aŋgip aŋgnimimb!” ’
Kun aŋgek kiyk am aŋgeniŋgambay, minim kuyip ak diyokniŋgambay. Gunap tap woŋg kiyk okok amniŋgambay. Gunap maniy woŋg kiyk ak geniŋgambay.
Pen gunap, kiyŋ bi nup gok gi timey giy, pikayey kumniŋgambay.
“Kun gey, kiyŋ niŋek simbwur nup ak timey gek, amiybi nuk gok aŋgyokek, am biynimb timey giniŋgambay kun gok kuyip pikaydiy, korip kuyip gok daŋgiyjiw pikey amniŋgamb.
Pen bi nup woŋg giñemb gok kuyip aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Keñmaŋgiy tap gok daŋgiy nan-gipun ak pen; biynimb nind suk aŋgnik gok ma opay.
Kun ak nimb am kinjeŋ tam okok mindiy, biynimb niŋnimimb okok kuyip monmon poŋind apem tap yomb ñiŋjun aŋgniŋgamb.’

Kun aŋgek binuk gok am kinjeŋ tam okok mindiy, biynimb timey giniŋgambay gok, biynimb tep giniŋgambay gok monmon poŋind apey; biyn diy tap yomb ñiŋniŋgambay korip miŋgan kun ak timbik giy yimb aŋgiy mindeniŋgamb.
“Bi kiyŋ ak pen; biynimb opay kun gok niŋiyn aŋgiy, korip miŋgan biyaŋ amiy niŋniŋgamb: bi bap chech ay korip miŋgan kun biyaŋ owep ak ay ma mindeniŋgamb.
Kun gek nup aŋgniŋgamb ‘Buŋgiy! Yenen, biyn diy tap ñiŋniŋg chech aypay ak ay mer; yikop nep ap mindpan?’ Aŋgek bi kun ak pen minim bap ma aŋgeniŋgamb,

bi kiyŋ ak binuk gok kuyip aŋgniŋgamb, ‘Bi biy ñin tomb nup gok tiwniŋgrimbikiy, dam kisyim owip namb akyaŋ diyokem, biynimb mindpay kun gok yip meŋg kamb siwbirikiy, siy aŋg mindeniŋgiy aŋgniŋgamb.’”
Jiysis paydoŋ ayak minim kun ak aŋgdiy, kuyip aŋgak, “Gor biynimb kuŋaynep suk aŋgip ak pen; maŋgiysek ma diniŋgamb. Biynimb gunap nep diniŋgamb aŋgak.”
Gapman Biyomb Siysa Nup Takes Ñemb Akaŋ Aŋgyak
Pen bi Peresiy gok, Jiysis nup minim yerip ak aŋgon, pen aŋgek niŋiy, nup dam miñ ayjun aŋgiy, minim aŋgniŋ aŋgniŋ giy,
bi kiyk key gunap, Herot binuk gunap yokey, Jiysis mindek ak amiy aŋgyak, “Nand bi minim niŋind yimb nep apan. Bi gunap niŋiy ma pirikpan, Gor aŋgip rek nep niŋiy biynimb aŋgñimban.
Kun ak nand gos yerip niŋban? Chin Yisrel biynimb gok, Siysa biyomb miñmon Rom nimb anup takes pikep akaŋ ma pikep?”
Aŋgeyak Jiysis minim yesek aŋgyak kun ak niŋiy aŋgak, “Yip yenen nembnemb giyiŋg ap kun giy aŋgniŋbim?
Takes pikpay maniy bap ñem niŋiyn aŋgak.” Aŋgek nup maniy won bap dap ñeyak niŋiy,
kuyip aŋgak, “Maniy won kun biy an kawnan ak sek, yimb ak sek mindip?”
Aŋgek aŋgyak, “Ak biyomb Siysa mindip aŋgyak.” Aŋgeyak Jiysis kuyip aŋgak, “Kun ak Siysa yip ginimimb aŋgip gok, nup ginimimb; Gor yip ginimimb aŋgiy niŋimb gok, nup ginimimb aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgek kiyk gos kuŋay niŋiy, nup kirgiy amniyak.
Kumiy Tip Tikjakpay Akaŋ Aŋgiy, Jiysis Nup Aŋgniŋyak
Ñin kun anep, Sanjiwsiy bi gunap Jiysis mindek ak wiyak. Sanjiwsiy biynimb gok biynimb kumiy tip ma tikjakpay apay ak mey,
Jiysis mindek ak apiy aŋgyak, “Tiysa. Mosis aŋgak, ‘Bi bap biyn diy, ñapan tikiy mer, yikop kumeniŋgamb, numam bap biyn kun ak diy, ñapan nup gok aŋgiy tikniŋgamb aŋgak.’

Kun ak, bi kiñiŋ sek onep ar ak mindeniŋgambay. Numam nind ak biyn diy, ñapan tikiy mer yikop kumniŋgamb. Kun gek, numam namb ak pen, biyn kun anep diy, ñapan tikiy mer, yikop kumniŋgamb. Kun anep gi dam dam, numam onep ar ak, maŋgiysek ñapan tikiy mer; yikop nep kumniŋgambay. Pen biyn ak kunep kumniŋgamb. Kun ak biynimb kumbay gok tikjakniŋgambay ñin ak, biyn kun ak an diniŋgamb?”
Aŋgeyak Jiysis kuyip pen aŋgak, “Nimb Baybol buk minim ak ma niŋiy, Gor gip rek ma niŋiy gipim ak mey, yesek aŋgiy apim, ‘Biynimb gok kumiy ma tikjakniŋgambay apim.’
Pen tikjakniŋgambay ñin ak, biyn gok bi ma diniŋgambay bi gok biyn ma diniŋgambay; enjol semb biyoŋ gok mindpay rek ak yikop mindeniŋgambay.
“Nimb biynimb kumiy ma tikjakpay apim ak, Baybol buk minim tikyak gunap ma niŋbim rek ayip.

Gor aŋgak, ‘Yand Gor yikop bap mer: Ebraham, Aysek, Jekop Gor kiyk mey, yand mindpiyn aŋgak.’ Biynimb pisnep kumbiyap ak, Gor yergiy bi nind kumyak kun gok bi yand apkop. Bi kumey komyak kun gok, kim mindpay ak mey; kuyip aŋgak, ‘Gor kiyk yand mindpiyn aŋgak.”
Jiysis minim kun ak aŋgek, biynimb mindeyak gok niŋey kuyip tep yimb gak.
Low Yomb Yimb Ak
Jiysis minim kun ak aŋgrep gek, Sanjiwsiy bi gok minim bap pen aŋgniŋgiy rek ma ayak. Pen bi Peresiy gunap, Jiysis aŋgak minim kun ak niŋiy, mindek ak wiyak.
Bi kiyk low niŋrep gak bap Jiysis yerip rek aŋgnimuŋ aŋgiy aŋgak,
“Tiysa. Gor low ayak minim ak, minim ar akay nup, minim yomb yimb mindip?”
Aŋgek Jiysis aŋgak, “‘Gos timund nand ak maŋgiysek Gor ker amek, nup wasemb yimb aynimin.’
Minim yomb yimb mey kun ak.
Minim yomb bap mey; ‘Nand key wasemb aypan rek biynimb gunap kuyip, wasemb aynimin.’
Gor low minim Mosis tikak gok sek, bi minim nup aŋgep gunap tikyak gok sek maŋgiysek, minim junj yomb yimb mey omiŋal kun ak nep aŋgak.”
Jiysis Aŋgak Bi Kiyŋ Yomb Key Yimb Apim Ak An Aŋgak
Peresiy kay ap nan-giy mindyakniŋ, Jiysis kuyip minim bap aŋgniŋiy aŋgak,
“Nimb Kiyŋ yomb key yimb ak nup yerip gos niŋbim? Nup an ñinuk aŋgiy niŋbim?” Aŋgek, “Depiyt ñinuk aŋgyak.”
Aŋgey Jiysis aŋgak, “Niŋind apim ak pen, Gor Kawnan ak Depiyt nup gos ñakniŋ, nuk Kiyŋ yomb chin anup ‘Biyomb yand’ aŋgak. Minim aŋgak kun ak, Baybol buk tikiy aŋgyak ak niŋbim. Depiyt aŋgak:

content.text: ‘Gor Biyomb yip anup minim aŋgay aŋgip, “Nand kund bak yip ak mindiy mey; yand gen biynimb nip alemb alemb ñimbay gok kuyip, tomb beŋ okok tawbirikniŋgamban aŋgip” aŋgak.’

content: Depiyt aŋgak kun ak nimb yenen apim, ‘Depiyt tikek, tik dand amiy, bi kiyŋ yomb key yimb ak nup tikpay apim.’ Pen Depiyt Biyomb yimb nuk ak mey, kiyŋ yomb key yimb apkip ak tep aŋgak.”
Jiysis minim nuk ak aŋgrep gek, kiyk nup pen aŋgniŋgiy rek ma ayek mey, kisen nup minim kun gok rek gunap sek ma aŋgniŋyak.
